courses.title: Healing and Awakening: Daylong Retreat with Ken Bradford
courses.description: An in-person daylong at the Nevada City Insight Center that joins emotional healing with spiritual awakening, through mindfulness, tonglen, nondual presence, guided inquiry and dialogue. Pre-registration needed; it runs only with at least eight people.

courses.title: Sound Healing Meditation with Miyu Tamamura
courses.description: An in-person evening of meditation with crystal bowls at Mountain Stream, held most months on a Thursday. Offered for a suggested donation shared between the musician and the centre.

left_out: Room to Breathe recovery sangha (weekly, Fridays): passes the new health rule (peer-led Buddhist approach to addiction recovery, no medical claim), but it is peer-led rather than taught and has only one dated page per meeting, no standing page; not restored.
Sound healing video ('Resonance - Sound of Stillness', mtstream.org/resonance-sound-of-stillness): a video page, handled separately.
flags: The sound healing evening repeats monthly but the site has only a dated page per evening; the 3 Dec 2026 evening is listed as a dated item and will drop off after that day. A later month's page could replace it.
Ken Bradford's daylong speaks of releasing 'emotional wounds & trauma' and managing stress; emotional healing, allowed under the new rule.
